facts.premium: Thailand's newest province; ~91% informal, the most rubber-dependent in Isan.
facts.skill_gap: Minimal formal sector; economy is rubber smallholding and farming.
anchors: Para-rubber — the main cash crop, unusual for Isan
impacts: Rubber is the dominant cash crop; firmer rubber prices (OAE +25% YoY) lift income, falls hurt.
Rubber yield and rice both depend on rainfall; weather drives cash flow.
A single-crop economy is highly exposed if rubber prices reverse.
A planned new crossing could open cross-border trade upside.
Lowest vehicle stock and EV count in Isan; very thin collateral depth.
